messages:
maria_gonzalez: Quick sync on the ACME POC — customer wants clear success criteria and a decision on deployment mode. They explicitly asked about Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private and want EU data residency. Timeline they gave: 4 weeks for a pilot with demo and a short eval report. Also attached a security questionnaire they expect answers to by next Tue. Can we outline scope, success metrics, and recommended deployment?

tim_chen: Thanks — high level suggestion: 1) narrow use cases (chat summarization + intent routing + embeddings search), 2) small eval prompt set (20 prompts per use case), 3) metrics: latency p50/p95, token cost per 10k gen, embedding recall@10, and failure rate <1%. :thumbsup:

alex_sato: For EU residency we can do Hosted in eu-west-1 if they accept multi-tenant. If they insist on strict isolation or KMS/HSM, propose Dedicated or Private (VPC). Dedicated gives predictable throughput for heavy concurrency; Private if they need on-prem or air-gapped.

maria_gonzalez: Customer's security team pushed for KMS + SOC2 logs. They seem open to Dedicated if pricing looks reasonable. Any quick pricing delta we can share?

tim_chen: Pricing sketch: Hosted (pay-as-you-go) — best for fast start, no infra commits. Dedicated — reserved capacity (monthly commit) with lower per-token cost and guaranteed throughput. Private — license + infra + support, longest lead time. I'll attach a simple table in the follow-up.

alex_sato: Ops notes: Dedicated provisioning lead ~2 weeks for GPU pool sizing if we need p95 < 300ms for gen with 2k concurrent users. Private on-prem is 6+ weeks with infra validation. Also note quantization/FP16 options can reduce GPU needs.

tim_chen: Proposed POC plan (2-3 week active):
- Week 0: Kickoff + security questionnaire answers (we can fill in most items, need customer contacts)
- Week 1: Data prep + small eval harness + baseline run on Hosted EU region
- Week 2: Run prompt set, collect metrics, iterate prompts, test failover to Dedicated if we hit concurrency/cost limits
- Week 3: Demo + short report + next-step recommendation

maria_gonzalez: Success criteria we should confirm with customer: 1) p95 latency < 500ms for single-turn chat, 2) embedding recall@10 >= 0.8 for top-10, 3) cost <= target X per 1M tokens (need to confirm their budget), 4) security checklist items marked as satisfied or titled for remediation. I'll ask them to confirm numeric budget.

alex_sato: Quick config snippet for experiment so infra can size resources:
```
model: redwood-open-7b-q4
mode: hosted-eu-west-1
batching: 64
quantization: q4_0
max_tokens: 512
```

tim_chen: For the eval harness I'll seed prompts that cover edge cases and a small held-out set for regression checks. We should also run an embeddings recall test with 10k items (can subsample). If the Hosted run shows noisy latency under load, we propose moving to Dedicated and use the same prompt harness so results are comparable. :eyes:

maria_gonzalez: I'll reply to ACME with this plan and ask for: A) confirmation on budget and which security items are blockers, B) a primary technical contact, and C) whether they require a Dedicated SLA or can start on Hosted. I'll loop you both in. Thanks! :raised_hands:

deploy_bot: deployment-check: no active deployments for acme-poc; recommended next step: schedule hosted-eu-west-1 trial token and start eval harness.

tim_chen: One more—if they require KMS-backed encryption of logs, Dedicated supports customer-managed keys; Hosted supports envelope encryption but not customer KMS per tenant. Call that out in the reply.

maria_gonzalez: Noted. I'll flag KMS and SLA as decision points and push for answers in the kickoff. Closing this thread once I get their confirmation.
